body:
The selected Java versions do not yet have a complete extension/source closure. This bounded audit inventories 519 POMs and six Maven configurations from 70 retained inputs (902,064,509 bytes), records printing/profile/bootstrap provenance gaps, and provides custody/recovery checks. The inherited malformed archetype POM deliberately leaves the actual static inventory at exit 1; enumeration is complete, XML interpretation is not.

Current tested head: `b15a785f350d347c0c2c4ff07ac6e5681c1d9746`. Base: `ambisgis/main` at `fc77ab978e567ce5d55e3428d1249a3b332da09d`. GitHub readback: **MERGEABLE / CLEAN**. The only integration conflicts were GOV-02 paragraphs in both STATUS files. A normal merge preserves the cited audit commits, merged database/Jupyter evidence, and all approved GOV-02 corrections. PR #52 is merged; its older open/in-review wording is historical.

Fresh validation after integration: **28 Java audit/custody tests + 175 package tests passed**, with no failures/skips; strict plan validation and all four schema/example checks passed. [Fresh test receipts](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/blob/b15a785f350d347c0c2c4ff07ac6e5681c1d9746/plan/verification/java-audit-integration-package-tests.txt), [audit evidence](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/blob/b15a785f350d347c0c2c4ff07ac6e5681c1d9746/plan/docs/java-dependency-audit.md), [handoff and merge-order guidance](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/blob/b15a785f350d347c0c2c4ff07ac6e5681c1d9746/plan/docs/java-audit-handoff.md). Database/Jupyter native tests were not rerun. The initial host-schema failure and all prior audit evidence remain preserved.

Owner decision: review and approve this bounded audit/tooling checkpoint for a separate merge into main. Acceptance would not approve Java compilation/runtime behavior, the selected product tuple, licenses/security, FND-07/FND-08, or complete FND-02. FND-02 remains In progress. Review blocks merging only; source/compatibility engineering continues separately.

PR #55 depends on this ordinary branch PR; supported GitHub `stack` and `stackEntry` are null for both. After an explicitly approved #54 merge, verify the actual merged main, integrate it into #55 without rewriting history, retarget #55 to main, and assess its current diff/tests before a separate decision. Do not merge #55 into an obsolete intermediate branch. This update does not authorize any merge.

Refs #3.
